title: EviGraph: Towards Verifiable Evidence Construction for Information-Seeking Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.24667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic Web search can retrieve relevant information without establishing that the retrieved content actually supports the claims used in an answer. Existing agents typically keep search and evidence recording in a linear interaction trace and optimize primarily for final-answer correctness, providing limited supervision for intermediate grounding. We present EviGraph, a deep-search framework that separates search execution from evidence recording while using a shared policy for the trainable roles. An executor plans concise queries, a frozen evidence verifier inspects source pages and returns verbatim evidence items with an explicit polarity, and the policy maps those items to add/support graph requests that are checked by a deterministic structural validator. The resulting graph serves both as persistent working memory and as a source of dense process rewards, enabling reinforcement learning to directly supervise evidence construction

translated_title: EviGraph：面向信息寻求代理的可验证证据构建
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24667v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：智能体网络搜索可以检索相关信息，但无法确保检索到的内容确实支持答案中使用的声明。现有智能体通常将搜索和证据记录保持在线性交互轨迹中，并主要优化最终答案的正确性，对中间推理依据的监督有限。我们提出了EviGraph，一个深度搜索框架，它将搜索执行与证据记录分离，同时为可训练角色使用共享策略。执行器规划简洁查询，冻结的证据验证器检查源页面并返回带明确极性的逐字证据项，策略将这些项映射到添加/支持图请求，由确定性结构验证器检查。生成的图既作为持久工作记忆，也作为密集过程奖励的来源，使强化学习能够直接监督证据构建。
tldr: EviGraph通过分离搜索与证据记录并构建可验证的图结构，利用共享策略和强化学习直接监督证据构建，从而提升信息寻求代理的中间推理可靠性。
en_tdlr: EviGraph separates search from evidence recording and builds a verifiable graph structure, using a shared policy and reinforcement learning to directly supervise evidence construction, thereby improving intermediate grounding reliability for information-seeking agents.
